data.message: Come mingle and kick off the summit! Don't miss the Reception tonight at 7:00 p.m. at RIU Plaza Hotel - Salón Vallarta.
Join us at 5:30 p.m. to catch the bus to Tlaquepaque, where we'll explore the beautiful streets and enjoy dinner at El Abajeño.
Join us for a fun afternoon of bowling and lunch at Magno Boliches. We'll meet at 12:30 p.m. to take the bus from the Hotel.
We hope you enjoyed the experience and wish you a safe journey home. Looking forward to seeing you soon!
